title: Atlas Fleet Manager GA
description: Epic tracking general availability of Atlas Fleet Manager. GA requires dashboards, scheduling, OTA updates, alerting, onboarding and the Enterprise tier with SAML SSO. Enterprise SSO (ATL-212) is a hard launch requirement because Globex Logistics cannot roll out without it.

comments.author: sam@northwind.dev
comments.body: Go/no-go decision: GA on 2026-09-30, provided ATL-212 closes by 2026-09-26.

comments.author: sam@northwind.dev
comments.body: GA moved from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-14 because ATL-212 (SAML SSO) is still blocked on KeyGate. See #atlas-launch.

title: Fleet overview dashboard
description: Main Atlas landing dashboard showing robot status, battery, pick rate and error counts per site. Data refreshes every 15 seconds from the telemetry stream.

comments.author: jordan@northwind.dev
comments.body: Shipped to beta. P95 load time 1.2s on a 120-robot fleet.

title: Pick-shift scheduling
description: Let operators schedule robot shifts and charging windows per site. Includes recurring schedules and holiday overrides.

title: Remote OTA firmware updates
description: Push firmware updates to R2 Pickers from Atlas with staged rollouts (5% / 25% / 100%) and automatic halt on error spikes. Will be the delivery path for the 2.8.1 hotfix.

comments.author: raj@northwind.dev
comments.body: Reviewing. Want the halt threshold configurable before we use it for 2.8.1.

title: Beta feedback: fleet map performance
description: Umbrella Freight (Atlas beta) reports the live fleet map stutters and takes 6-8 seconds to render with 30 robots across two sites. Kai is redesigning marker clustering and reducing re-render frequency.

comments.author: kai@northwind.dev
comments.body: Clustering prototype cuts render to ~1.5s. Ollie is helping with the frontend changes.

title: Alerting rules and notifications
description: Configurable alerts for robot faults, low battery and offline robots, delivered by email and webhook. Includes a 5-minute deduplication window.

title: Onboarding wizard
description: Four-step wizard for new Atlas accounts: add site, pair robots, invite teammates, set alerts. Implements Kai's onboarding designs.

comments.author: kai@northwind.dev
comments.body: Looks great. Small spacing fixes on step 3, then good to merge.

title: Usage export to CSV
description: Add an Export button to the usage page that downloads robot-hours and picks per site as CSV for a chosen date range. Not required for GA.

title: Roles and permissions
description: Admin, Operator and Viewer roles scoped per site. SSO group-to-role mapping will plug into this once ATL-212 lands.

title: API keys for fleet integrations
description: Let admins create, scope and revoke API keys so customers can pull fleet status into their WMS. Keys are hashed at rest and shown once.

title: Atlas billing hookup
description: Meter active robots per month and bill Atlas at $40 per robot per month, or $55 for the Enterprise tier with SSO. Usage events flow to PayStream via the Billing v2 pipeline.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: Metering events are live in staging. Enterprise tier price ID created in PayStream.

title: Enterprise SAML SSO via KeyGate
description: SAML SSO for the Atlas Enterprise tier, brokered through KeyGate Identity. Blocked: KeyGate's SAML metadata endpoint serves a stale signing certificate after cert rotation, so assertion signature validation fails. Globex Logistics (120 robots, renewal 2026-11-30) cannot roll out Atlas without SSO.

comments.author: devon@northwind.dev
comments.body: KeyGate (Victor Osei) confirmed the signing-cert rotation bug in their SAML metadata endpoint. Fix ETA Oct 9.

comments.author: sam@northwind.dev
comments.body: Launch moved from Sep 30 to Oct 14 because of this.

comments.author: devon@northwind.dev
comments.body: KeyGate slipped the fix to "Oct 13 at the earliest". I will escalate to KeyGate's exec sponsor.

title: SSO login UI
description: Login screen with "Sign in with SSO" (email-domain discovery), error states for failed assertions, and the admin SSO settings page. UI is complete; it waits on the backend in ATL-212.

title: Proration bug overbills mid-cycle plan changes
description: The legacy billing service charged the full new rate for the whole cycle when a customer added robots mid-cycle, instead of prorating by day. Stark Distribution's July invoice was overbilled after they added units. Root cause was a day-count calculation using cycle start instead of change date.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: Fix deployed with regression tests for mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: Corrected Stark Distribution invoice reissued and credit applied. Audited other accounts: no other overbilling found.

title: Billing v2: PayStream usage-based cutover
description: Move invoicing from the legacy billing service to PayStream usage-based billing, per ADR-007. Run both systems in shadow mode for one cycle and compare invoices before cutover.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: September shadow run matched legacy invoices on 61 of 62 accounts; the one diff was a rounding issue, now fixed.

title: Backfill invoices into PayStream
description: Import 12 months of historical invoices from the legacy billing Postgres database into PayStream so customers see full history. Starts after the BIL-40 cutover.

title: Billing alerts dashboard
description: Dashboard and alerts for failed PayStream webhooks, invoice generation errors and unusual invoice deltas month over month. Would have caught the BIL-31 overbilling earlier.

title: Wi-Fi roaming drops after firmware 2.8
description: Since firmware 2.8 (released 2026-08-04), R2 Pickers drop Wi-Fi when roaming between access points and take 1-3 minutes to reconnect. 7+ support tickets so far from Hooli Retail, Acme Foods, Umbrella Freight, Wayne Supply Co, Initech Warehousing and Soylent Grocers. Root cause: 2.8 changed the roaming RSSI threshold and dropped 802.11r fast-transition handling.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Workaround that helps: disable band steering on the AP or roll back to 2.7.4. Linking new tickets here.

comments.author: raj@northwind.dev
comments.body: Fix restores the 2.7 roaming threshold and FT handling. Soak test on the lab fleet looks clean so far; cutting 2.8.1 (FW-80).

title: Add Wi-Fi roaming soak test to firmware CI
description: Add an automated 12-hour roaming soak test across three access points to firmware CI so roaming regressions like FW-77 are caught before release.

title: Firmware 2.8.1 hotfix release
description: Package and release firmware 2.8.1 containing the FW-77 roaming fix. Roll out in stages, starting with the most affected customers (Hooli Retail, Acme Foods).

comments.author: raj@northwind.dev
comments.body: Release candidate built. Ships once the FW-77 soak test passes 72 hours.

title: Refresh support macros
description: Rewrite the Zendesk support macros for tone and accuracy. Following the 2026-08-18 Support & Finance policy review, the refund macro now states a 30-day refund window.

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: All 18 macros updated. Refund request macro now says 30 days.

title: Create KB article for the Wi-Fi drop workaround
description: There is no FAQ or KB entry for the firmware 2.8 Wi-Fi roaming drops, so agents re-explain the workaround on every ticket. Document symptoms, the band-steering and rollback workaround, and the 2.8.1 hotfix status.
